strengths_deep_dive: The organization demonstrates a strong ability to mobilize material resources for newcomers. In 2023, they successfully <cite id="2">distributed $85,000 in financial aid</cite> and managed the logistics for <cite id="2">1,700 donated phones</cite>. These direct services provide immediate relief to families in transition. Furthermore, the charity was <cite id="2">awarded a Welcome Fund grant</cite> by Welcome.US, indicating some level of recognition from established resettlement partners.
rich_narrative.summary: Afghan Refugee Relief provides essential support to displaced families, yet its financial structure raises significant concerns regarding charitable efficiency. The organization focuses on direct service delivery, including <cite id="2">furnishing 200 homes</cite> and <cite id="2">distributing 750 laptops</cite> to refugees. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="5">total revenue of $205,225</cite> to support these operations. While the mission addresses a high-urgency humanitarian need, the financial allocation is problematic. The charity reported a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 28.9%</cite> in FY2024. This means less than one-third of total spending reached direct programs. This figure is significantly below the <cite id="1">industry standard of 75%</cite> and the <cite id="1">peer median of 89.8%</cite>. Despite these efficiency gaps, the organization maintains <cite id="1">low fundraising costs of $0.07</cite> for every dollar raised. The charity also manages a high volume of donated goods, having <cite id="2">received 1,700 phones</cite> for distribution. However, with only <cite id="1">1.3 months of working capital</cite>, the organization operates with a very lean financial cushion. This limited reserve makes long-term sustainability and response to sudden crises difficult.
